name: duskhaul-grit-fullbleed
artStyle: Grimdark gritty pixel art ground texture seen straight from above: chunky low-resolution pixels rendered crisp, dithered two-step shading only, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no painterly edges. Surfaces are dirty and wet: cracked stone, packed mud, grit, each stone carrying at most one small damp highlight. Flat even coverage edge to edge with no focal object, no vignette and no perspective. Forbidden: clean saturated cartoon colour, glossy plastic finish, lettering, characters, creatures, props.
camera: Orthographic straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, constant scale, no horizon, no perspective.
lighting: Even dim dusk ambient over the whole ground, no light pool, no vignette, no cast shadows; one faint damp highlight on some stone tops.
outline: Stones are separated by dark grout lines in #2b2431; no outline around the canvas.

plan.temperature: Gameplay colour code, non-negotiable per asset: threat is dried-blood red #c0392b glows and telegraphs; reward is gilt #d9a24b shimmer on shards, relics and chests; extraction and arcane are dusk-violet #5b4bff light; the player and allies carry a gloam-green #8a9a5b rim; hazard telegraphs are torch-amber #e8c547. The world itself stays cold desaturated plum-grey so every coded hue reads at thumbnail size.

focal.primary: nothing: a floor is rest space for the actors drawn on it
focal.secondary: stone joints and cracks at an even rhythm

materials.bone: dry porous bone in parchment tones, chipped edges, two value steps, mud in the joints
materials.metal: rusted pitted iron, one thin wet specular along the struck edge, dark red-brown rust bloom
materials.cloth: rotten sodden cloth hanging heavy, ragged hems, two value steps, never a clean fold
materials.stone: wet cracked stone with moss seams, one damp highlight band where torchlight lands
materials.flesh: grey-green cadaver flesh, sunken, matte, darkest at the joints
materials.energy: hard-edged pixel glow in dusk violet or torch amber, a bright core and one dithered fringe step, never a soft bloom
materials.wood: split rain-black timber, straight sparse grain, iron nails

note: Full-bleed variant of art/style.json for floors/roads/splats only (game-art rule 1 scope exception): same palette/plan, anchors removed because xai redraws the vision anchor into tiles; lighting/camera prose rewritten because the actor profile forbids a ground plane.
